claims.assertion: Isolated language-fidelity review completed for the proposed translated and meaning-sensitive wording.
claims.review_note: 2026-09-24; agent /root/finnish_language; fork_turns=none. Received neutral passages/URLs and candidate wording only; no research conclusions, evidence statuses, PR discussion or workflow. Finnish -> English and English paraphrase check. Comparisons: (1) Original 'tulee olla saavutettavuusseloste' -> 'must have an accessibility statement'; final 'Yes': Supported for covered digital services, not products. (2) Original 'tulee olla helposti saatavilla' -> 'must be easily available'; source also requires continuing updates; final research phrase 'An easily available, up-to-date accessibility statement is required for covered websites and mobile apps': Supported (statement-info introduction). (3) English scope/supervision source: final 'Products, E-commerce, Banking, Electronic communications, Transport, Audiovisual access and E-books: Traficom (covered products and services)': Supported with qualifier retained. (4) English source 'answering to the single European emergency number and the accessibility of the number'; initial 'answering accessibility' Ambiguous; final '112 emergency calls: Ministry of the Interior (answering and accessibility)' rechecked Supported. (5) Notification-source original 'Service providers must notify Traficom in two situations'; final 'Company non-compliance: Traficom notification form': Supported as operator self-report, covered scope. (6) Original 'invokes the ground for a derogation'; initial 'Exemptions' Ambiguous; final 'Exemptions (invoking derogation grounds): Traficom notification form' rechecked Supported. (7) Complaint-source form/email wording; final 'Public complaints (digital services): Traficom complaint form or saavutettavuus@traficom.fi': Supported. Finnish law titles retained verbatim and linguistically sound; chapter 3a faithfully renders 3 a luku. English acceptance is preserved contributor information without original-language evidence, not independently language-verified. AI comparison is not human/legal approval or proof of exhaustive authority coverage. User presentation decision supersedes the longer reviewed label: publish exactly 'Exemptions:'. The route remains a notification of reliance on the relevant grounds; the substantive scope is unchanged. The earlier language verdict is historical, not a recheck of this user-selected label.
